en.title: Jon Watts Pilots Next Star Wars Movie, Launching New Skywalker Saga Trilogy
en.summary: The director behind the beloved Spider-Man trilogy is officially taking the helm for the next cinematic chapter of the Star Wars universe. This highly anticipated film is set to kick off a fresh trilogy, continuing the epic Skywalker Saga.
en.body:
The Force is strong with this news: **Jon Watts**, the architect of Marvel's recent **Spider-Man** adventures, is set to direct the next feature film in the **Star Wars** saga. This isn't just any standalone story; the movie is slated to launch a brand-new trilogy, continuing the narrative threads of the enduring Skywalker Saga. While details are still emerging, fans can expect a fresh perspective from a director who has proven his mettle in crafting compelling, high-stakes blockbusters that resonate with global audiences.

Watts' previous work, particularly the **Tom Holland**-led **Spider-Man** trilogy – including **Spider-Man: Homecoming**, **Spider-Man: Far From Home**, and the multiversal phenomenon **Spider-Man: No Way Home** – showcases his talent for balancing expansive action with intimate character moments. Before he swung into the Marvel Cinematic Universe, Watts also honed his skills on independent films like **Cop Car** and **Clown**, demonstrating a versatile directorial vision. Now, he's tasked with steering the galaxy far, far away into its next era. Scripting duties for this new trilogy fall to **Simon Kinberg**, a seasoned writer and producer known for his work on the **X-Men** franchise.

## A Familiar Face Returns

Adding another layer of intrigue, **Daisy Ridley** is confirmed to reprise her role as Rey. However, the focus will shift, with Ridley's character not serving as the central protagonist this time around. This suggests a deliberate effort to expand the **Star Wars** universe beyond established figures, potentially introducing new heroes and exploring different corners of the galaxy while still honoring its rich legacy. The presence of both Watts and Ridley hints at a thoughtful approach to continuing the Skywalker Saga, aiming to satisfy longtime fans while forging new narrative paths.

## Galactic Stakes for Fans

For the passionate global community of **Star Wars** fans, this announcement carries significant weight. The Skywalker Saga, while having seemingly concluded with **The Rise of Skywalker**, remains the emotional core of the franchise for many. Entrusting its continuation to **Jon Watts**, a director who has navigated the complexities of a beloved, multi-film arc with immense success, offers a beacon of hope for high-quality storytelling. The involvement of **Simon Kinberg** as writer further solidifies the creative team's pedigree. The prospect of a new trilogy, coupled with the return of **Rey**, sparks immediate debate and excitement about where the narrative might venture next, what new characters will emerge, and how the established lore will be honored and expanded upon.

## What's Next

While a specific release date for the first film in this new trilogy has not yet been officially announced, the current projection places it around 2026. Fans will be eagerly awaiting further details regarding the plot, supporting cast, and the precise direction Lucasfilm plans to take this next chapter of the **Star Wars** saga.
